[CIR-2026-07 | Circular CIR-2026-07 v1.0 | Front matter] Circular CIR-2026-07 NexaHome Loan: Processing Fee Revision and Part-Prepayment Relaxation
Document IDCIR-2026-07
Issued on2026-06-15
Effective from2026-07-01
AmendsPOL-HL-V3 (NexaHome Loan Policy v3.0), clauses 6.2 and 8.3 only
Issued byRetail Credit Policy Committee, NexaBank
[CIR-2026-07 | Circular CIR-2026-07 v1.0 | 1. Background] 1.1 Background. The Retail Credit Policy Committee has revised the processing fee and the minimum part prepayment amount for NexaHome Loan. This circular amends two clauses of POL-HL-V3. All other clauses of POL-HL-V3 are unchanged. [CIR-2026-07 | Circular CIR-2026-07 v1.0 | 2. Instrument and precedence] 2.1 Precedence. For the clauses named in this circular, this circular prevails over POL-HL-V3 from the effective date for the loans covered by clause 5.1 of this circular.
Clause of POL-HL-V3SubjectStatus from 2026-07-01
6.2Processing feeReplaced by clause 3.1 of this circular
8.3Part prepayment minimumReplaced by clause 4.1 of this circular
[CIR-2026-07 | Circular CIR-2026-07 v1.0 | 3. Revised processing fee] 3.1 Revised clause 6.2. Processing fee is 0.30% of the sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹5,000 and a maximum of ₹10,000, plus GST. The earlier terms were 0.35%, minimum ₹5,000 and maximum ₹15,000. [CIR-2026-07 | Circular CIR-2026-07 v1.0 | 4. Revised part prepayment minimum] 4.1 Revised clause 8.3. The minimum part prepayment amount is ₹10,000. The earlier minimum was ₹25,000. No charge applies on a floating-rate loan. [CIR-2026-07 | Circular CIR-2026-07 v1.0 | 5. Applicability and grandfathering] 5.1 Loans covered. The revised processing fee applies only to loans sanctioned on or after 2026-07-01. Loans sanctioned before that date keep the processing fee that applied at sanction, and no refund or adjustment is made. [CIR-2026-07 | Circular CIR-2026-07 v1.0 | 5. Applicability and grandfathering] 5.2 Existing borrowers and part prepayment. Borrowers whose NexaHome loans were sanctioned under POL-HL-V3 before 2026-07-01 may opt in to the revised ₹10,000 part prepayment minimum by written request to their branch or through a service request. There is no charge for opting in. Until a borrower opts in, the ₹25,000 minimum continues to apply to that loan. Opting in does not change the processing fee already paid. [CIR-2026-07 | Circular CIR-2026-07 v1.0 | 6. Unchanged terms] 6.1 Terms not affected. Eligibility, interest rate spreads, FOIR limits, LTV, legal and technical charges, penal charges and foreclosure terms in POL-HL-V3 are not affected by this circular.
